prompt: Write a TypeScript script that builds a Sui PTB to mint an NFT via moveCall, set its description via a second moveCall using the result from the first, and then transfer it to a recipient — all in one transaction. Use Transaction from @mysten/sui/transactions.
expectations: First moveCall result is captured and passed to second moveCall
Final result transferred to recipient with transferObjects
All operations composed in a single Transaction

prompt: Write a TypeScript script that builds a PTB to create a Kiosk, place an item into it, and list it for sale at a given price — all in one transaction. Use moveCall with 0x2::kiosk targets. Use Transaction from @mysten/sui/transactions.
expectations: Creates Kiosk via moveCall to 0x2::kiosk::new or 0x2::kiosk::default
Lists item via moveCall to 0x2::kiosk::list with price
